title: Prompt size per Misato turn, measured
goal: A bounded local sample says how large a local-route turn is and how much of it is tool schemas
acceptance: Each Misato call records route, estimated prompt tokens and the tool-schema share into a bounded SQLite sample (rate and retention bounded, no request text); a committed test
`nerv doctor` or a report command prints the last day's median and maximum per route
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git; the sample stores sizes, never text.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-16: a sample table like the F-103 health samples, one hook in the Misato call, a report line. Not a measurement.
